title: The Ghosts' Greenhouse

hints.text: Keep moving toward the rear of the expanded Haunted Mansion garden.
Look for an ornate structure made from iron and glass rather than another statue.
Find the Mansion greenhouse at the back of the garden and inspect its unusual plant collection.

revealDescription: At the rear of the grounds is an ornate iron-and-glass greenhouse presented as a place where the Mansion's ghostly residents cultivate unusual plants.
